derivation.network: Rebuilt Ethernet/IP/TCP metadata; documentation addresses, fixed ports/MACs, relative sequences, no TCP options, timestamps shifted to 1 while preserving intervals.
derivation.payload: All selected TCP application payloads unchanged; packet indices and per-payload SHA-256 in provenance files.
derivation.normalization: Native ICSNPP transaction projections; UIDs replaced with fixture IDs. Packet timing/order equivalence is not asserted.
derivation.scope: Upstream analyzer test traffic, not operational telemetry or confirmed attacks. The deny profile is a labeled policy counterfactual.
